player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee leek {player_id} ku SimpleTak.
Ku board, kɔc wei yin ee ku '{player_stone}' ku kɔc wei dhuk ee ku '{opponent_stone}'.

Ku wɛ̈ɛ̈r yin, akɔ̈ɔ̈n pamac (ku yɔ̈ɔ̈k deŋ) ku yɔ̈ɔ̈ kɔc wei yin tɛ̈ɛ̈.
Ku yɛ̈ɛ̈k, '[12]' yɔ̈ɔ̈ kɔc wei yin ku yɛ̈ɛ̈k 12.

Ku yɛ̈ɛ̈k yin ee kuɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔc wei yin ku bɛ̈ɛ̈i kɔ̈k kuɔ̈ɔ̈r wɛ̈ɛ̈r ku bɛ̈ɛ̈i pamac kuɔ̈ɔ̈r (wɛ̈ɛ̈r-ku-bɛ̈ɛ̈i ku bɛ̈ɛ̈i-ku-wɛ̈ɛ̈r).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: Acie path ba ya lɔ̈ɔ̈m ëbɛ̈n.
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Thïn cell {cell_num} acë luel. Këcë kuat 0 na {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Cell {cell_num} acï tɔ̈u. Ka kuany cell cïn këde yic.

action.placement: Wär {current_player_id} acë kekë nhom ({symbol}) thïn cell {cell_num}.

outcome.draw: Aci yic thiäŋ. Ee kë ye kɔc thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ!
